<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
load_safetensors(path, *, mmap: bool = True) -> SafetensorsFile
```

Part of [`evoxc.formats`](/api/evoxc/formats/)

Open and validate a safetensors file.

## Parameters

- `path` — Path to the `.safetensors` file.

- `mmap` · `bool` — `True` (default) memory-maps the file and returns zero-copy
  read-only views from `SafetensorsFile.tensor`; `False`
  reads eagerly and returns independent writable arrays.

## Returns

- `SafetensorsFile` — A validated `SafetensorsFile`.  Close it (or use it as a context manager) when done.
